pages.text: The frog packed his bundle to leave. Kota turned away and hid behind a post.
"Won't you say goodbye?" Dad asked. "I won't see him off." Kota pressed their forehead to the post.
As the frog's footsteps faded, tears filled Kota's eyes. "I hate goodbyes."
Dad took Kota's paw and led them to the gate. They could still see the frog. "Let's send a wave he can see from far away."
Kota gave a little wave. The frog didn't see and kept walking. Kota's heart sank.
"Bigger!" Dad raised his whole arm. They both waved high and wide. "Bye! See you again!"
Far down the path, the frog jumped and waved back with all his might. Their goodbye had reached him! Kota's tail rose.
The frog gave one last wave at the mountain bend, then disappeared. Kota's heart stayed warm. Tears and smiles came together.
"One, come to the gate. Two, wave big! Three, say 'See you again!'" Kota practiced their goodbye.
Dad closed the gate and hugged Kota. "A big goodbye brings the next meeting closer." Kota showed him once more. "Big waves, see you again!"
